request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fabric, building and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A MECHANIC. A woman of about thirty with her hair in a ponytail, in dark-blue work overalls with a little grease on them, stands in a car repair garage beside a car with its hood open; she holds a large wrench in one hand and leans over the engine, looking at the camera with a small smile. Tools hang on the wall behind. The overalls are completely plain. Exactly one person, whole upper body sharp and large in the middle of the photo; the workplace behind is plain to read but not crowded. No letters, words, numbers, logos, badges with writing or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
